PROMISSORY NOTE

$275,000.00                                                        Portland, Oregon
                                                                   May 18, 2026

FOR VALUE RECEIVED, Kirkbride Ceramics LLC, an Oregon limited liability company ("Borrower"), promises to pay to the order of Halvard Ostrowski-Nnamdi, or his assigns ("Lender"), the principal sum of Two Hundred Seventy-Five Thousand and 00/100 Dollars ($275,000.00), together with interest, on the terms below.

1. Interest. Interest accrues on the outstanding principal balance at a fixed rate of seven and one-half percent (7.50%) per annum, computed on the basis of a 365-day year and the actual number of days elapsed. Interest begins to accrue on the date of this Note.

2. Payments. Borrower shall pay interest only, monthly in arrears, on the first day of each month beginning July 1, 2026. The entire unpaid principal balance, together with all accrued and unpaid interest, is due and payable in full on June 1, 2029 (the "Maturity Date"). Each payment shall be applied first to accrued interest and then to principal. Payments shall be made to Lender at 3410 Southeast Belmont Street, Portland, Oregon 97214, or at any other address Lender designates in writing.

3. Prepayment. Borrower may prepay all or any part of the principal at any time without penalty or premium. A partial prepayment does not excuse any later scheduled payment.

4. Late Charge. If any payment is not received within ten (10) days after it is due, Borrower shall pay a late charge of five percent (5%) of the overdue amount, which the parties agree is a reasonable estimate of Lender's administrative cost and not a penalty.

5. Default Interest. From and after the occurrence of an Event of Default, the unpaid principal balance bears interest at the lesser of twelve percent (12%) per annum or the maximum rate permitted by Oregon law.

6. Events of Default. Each of the following is an "Event of Default": (a) Borrower fails to pay any amount within ten (10) days after it is due; (b) Borrower fails to perform any other obligation under this Note or the Security Agreement and does not cure the failure within thirty (30) days after written notice; (c) Borrower makes an assignment for the benefit of creditors, or a bankruptcy petition is filed by or against Borrower and, if filed against Borrower, is not dismissed within sixty (60) days; or (d) any representation Borrower made in connection with this Note proves to have been materially false when made.

7. Acceleration. On an Event of Default, Lender may declare the entire unpaid principal balance and all accrued interest immediately due and payable, without presentment, demand, protest, or further notice of any kind, all of which Borrower waives.

8. Security. This Note is secured by a security interest in the equipment described in the Security Agreement between Borrower and Lender dated May 18, 2026, and by a UCC-1 financing statement filed with the Oregon Secretary of State.

9. Usury Savings. Nothing in this Note requires Borrower to pay interest at a rate exceeding the maximum rate permitted by applicable law. If any amount paid or contracted to be paid would exceed that maximum, the excess shall be applied to reduce principal, and any remainder shall be refunded to Borrower.

10. Costs of Collection. Borrower shall pay Lender's reasonable costs of collection, including reasonable attorneys' fees, incurred in enforcing this Note, whether or not suit is filed.

11. Waivers. Borrower waives presentment for payment, demand, protest, and notice of dishonor. No delay or omission by Lender in exercising any right operates as a waiver of that right, and a waiver on one occasion is not a waiver on any other.

12. Governing Law. This Note is governed by the laws of the State of Oregon, without regard to its conflict-of-laws rules. Borrower consents to the jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in Multnomah County, Oregon.

13. Notices. Notices under this Note must be in writing and are effective on personal delivery, on the next business day after deposit with a nationally recognized overnight courier, or three (3) business days after deposit in the United States mail, certified, return receipt requested, to the addresses stated above.

14. Successors. This Note binds Borrower and its successors and assigns and benefits Lender and Lender's successors and assigns. Borrower may not assign or delegate its obligations under this Note without Lender's prior written consent.

BORROWER:

KIRKBRIDE CERAMICS LLC,
an Oregon limited liability company

By: /s/ Ingrid Kirkbride-Adeyemi
Name: Ingrid Kirkbride-Adeyemi
